Results.ReviewText: Can't beat Weber Kettle.  I am a long time Weber customer, having several charcoal and gas grills throughout the years. Results.ReviewText: If you are looking to get a Weber Kettle a Master Touch is a Must Have you will not regret it. from getting the charcoal baskets, Warming Rack and the GBS Grate makes the Master Touch the grill you want over just the regular Weber Kettle. I have just owned mine for 3-4 Weeks and have already had over 10 Cooks on it. I could not be more pleased. with the addition of a Vortex & Grill Grate there is nothing I can not grill or smoke on my Master Touch. I am looking forward to getting some of the GBS Attachments to make it even more versatile. So far I have grilled Steaks, Burgers, Brats, Italian Sausages, Chicken Wings, & Polska Kielbasa. I have also Smoked a Pork Tenderloin & Bacon Wrapped meatloaf. once you learn how to control your temp and what Internal temp to cook your meat to the possibilities are endless. the more i use my Master Touch the more I want to use it. Cleanup is super easy it has taken me less than 5 minutes to completely clean and remove the ash from the ash tray. I have nothing bad to say about this Grill and for anyone looking to get a grill I am telling you that there is nothing you can not grill/smoke on this Master Touch.
Results.Title: The Master Touch is the 1 Grill you Need

Although it takes a little bit of effort to put it together if you purchase it un-assembled and the grill legs could be a little sturdier, we strongly recommend this reasonably priced charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText:
It’s a good grill but definitely has room for improvement. My biggest complaint is how cheap this grill feels. Although I didn’t damage the legs during the installation, it sure felt like I was.

The whole tripod thing has got to go. You really have to be careful about moving this grill around the yard. It felt like I was going to bend the front leg inwards when it got caught up on the lawn when I was rolling it out. I’m really not a big fan of the cheap tires either. Let’s not even talk about the tiny rack underneath. That thing holds my chimney and that’s about it. 

The real satisfaction from this Weber is the kettle. This is where you really get your bang for your buck. Equipped with a Ten-year warranty on the kettle, makes it easier to pull the trigger on purchasing one. The possibility of being the last grill you’ll ever have to buy, well that's the ends justifying the means. 

The potential is definitely there. However, until Weber redesigns or upgrades everything underneath that kettle. It’s just not worth the Five Stars. 

I’m sorry, but that’s just my humble and honest opinion.
Results.Title: Almost there

Results.ReviewText:
First off, buying anything anymore made in the USA little loan in my state of Illinois is a huge plus. Assembly was way easier than most grills I have owned or seen. Although the legs are a bit tight and if you don't have a lot of grip or upper strength it may be a challenge for you putting them in. Everything else was a cake walk and took me about as much time getting everything out of box as it did putting it together. There is a good amount of grilling area and the grill grate with it's swing open sides and pull out center are convenient. Also they don't really hinder the use of a turner which was a concern for me so great job Weber.

Now for the cons. If you go to brush your grill with any effort, don't expect it to be rock solid. The legs are thinner gauge aluminum than i think they should be and this thing twists like no other grill I have owned. I don't think it will break anytime soon but metal fatigue my be an issue later on. Also if you have had an acorn or some insulated grill of some sort this will chew thru charcoal to get the heat you want for searing or even 300-400 range. Also the lid keeper could be built better to allow it to rest straight up instead of angled in towards the grilling area. Another thing, make sure you realize that you check the height over before you buy. From what I've seen they are on the shorter side. Your back will thank you. 
 

All in all I'm pleased. If you are a hamburger or hot dog person just trying to feed yourself or a crowd it will do you well. For someone that likes high heat. Have stock in lump charcoal.

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been using Weber charcoal grills for 42+ years, there is no better grill in my opinion.  I’ve had Smokey Joe’s all the way up to the 26”, all of them basic grills.  I don’t believe any of them ever burned/ rusted out.  Early on I would buy the next larger and give away the previous.  This Master-Touch is a big upgrade from the basic grill.  Love the temp gauge, charcoal mgmt set up and the grill with the hole in it for other cooking options.  I might just try a few of the accessories for that.  It went together easily and it seems to be of the same quality as the previous Weber’s albeit maybe a little thinner metal, especially the legs.  I was shocked on how thin the leg tubes are, one actually has a dent/ crimp in it, doesn’t affect function, hopefully it will hold up over the years.  The actual grill rack seems like it is a much heavier gauge material which should last even longer!  Overall after first burn it functions as expected.

14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
